_catalogAudit.verdict: NO equippable level-60 gear is missing. All six level-50+ absentees are patterns, recipes, scopes and crafting materials (Pattern: Blue Dragonscale Armor Kit, Recipe: Freshly Brewed Firewater, Leyline Research, Recipe: Miru Berry Wine, Radley's Special Scope, Fel Dust). The 10.6% coverage gap is low-level items and non-gear, none of which belong in a level-60 BiS planner. Our Worldforged catalog is complete for its purpose.
